notes.title: Playtest Update: Mission editor and new map!
notes.notes:
[p]Pilots! A brand-new version of the Battle of BackYard Playtest has just been deployed—and it’s a big one. This update brings fresh air and allows for Your creativity![/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/e891c09aea55d03128b3b3c48a3b9dfbd918ed58.png"][/img] [/p][h2]New map: Dadventure Bay Lake[/h2][p]A wide-open stretch of water with plenty of sky to burn and just enough terrain for cover.[/p][p]Perfect for long-range bombing runs, torpedo ambushes, or full-speed aerial jousting over the dock chairs.

[/p][h2]Mission editor: now fully functional[/h2][p]You've asked, we delivered: the mission editor is now in your hands![/p][p]Build your own missions, scatter buildings, place objectives, and challenge your friends in custom-built chaos.[/p][list][*][p]Set up fuel-starved scenarios[/p][/*][*][p]Fortify the skies with AA bunkers[/p][/*][*][p]Design impossible challenges for your squad (or your enemies)[/p][/*][*][p]And then play them live with friends
[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugs? Probably.[/h2][p]This is still the early testing phase, so some things might explode unintentionally (or too intentionally). That’s where you come in.[/p][p][b]Join our Discord[/b], report bugs, share your mission setups, and help us shape the game into the glorious backyard battlefield it’s meant to be.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44747577/e345b312756ddbc1150fcbc55dc42fa9ea2118db.png"][/img][/p]
